title: Lockeland Loft
description:
Private entrance to loft apartment above the main house with one bedroom and an additional single sleeping area.  Guests have key code access and convenient parking.

The space
The loft is a comfortable suite for three guests, one private bedroom with a queen bed and an additional cozy sleeping nook for one.  There is a large common area for hanging out, a kitchenette perfect for bringing the to-go boxes home, and one bathroom.  This is the second level of a single family home with a private entrance for guests, located in the historic Lockeland Springs neighborhood in East Nashville.

Guest access
Off street driveway parking and access by key code to guest space.

Other things to note
Quiet, walkable residential area but close to the excitement of East Nashville and the Honky Tonks of Lower Broad.
